_README: Crisis resources shown by the hard-tier guardrail. SAFETY-CRITICAL DATA. Per PRD §10 (Open Questions) the per-country helpline list and the on-screen copy are BLOCKING items that must be reviewed and signed off by a clinical advisor before any real launch. The entries below are intentionally minimal and conservative: only resources we can state with confidence are included. Country-specific lines are left for clinical review rather than guessed — do NOT populate them with unverified numbers.
_reviewStatus: UNREVIEWED — placeholder for clinical sign-off (see PRD §10)

copy.heading: Before anything plays — you deserve real support
copy.body: It sounds like you're going through something really heavy right now. You don't have to carry it alone, and talking to a person can help more than a playlist can. Reaching out is a strong thing to do.
copy.aiDisclosure: You're talking to Spotify's AI DJ, not a person. The contacts below connect you to trained humans.
